x_cookie_jar.lore.uncommon: Is shaped like a smiling bear whose head comes off, which makes every snack feel a bit rude.

can.lore.common: Sits in the cupboard with its label half torn off, so dinner is always a surprise.
can.lore.uncommon: Dents itself on the way home from the shop and then refuses to stack.

i_bottlecap.lore.uncommon: Gets saved in a pocket for a collection and goes through the washing machine with a clank.

i_pill_bottle.lore.rare: Hides its tiny instructions in writing so small that the whole family needs glasses to read it.

milk_carton.lore.uncommon: Gets put back in the fridge with one sip left, so whoever finds it is cross.

sushi.lore.rare: Turns any meal into a puzzle of chopsticks, soy sauce and one very brave dab of wasabi.

x_hot_chocolate.lore.uncommon: Grows a wrinkly skin on top if it is left for a minute, which half the family loves.

x_hummus.lore.legendary: Was made so smooth at a picnic that a grandma said it was the best she'd ever had, and she'd had a lot.

x_salsa.lore.uncommon: Drips red juice down every tortilla chip and onto the tablecloth.
x_salsa.lore.rare: Sneaks a chunk of chilli onto the one chip that the bravest person didn't check.

x_soda.lore.legendary: Made a burp so loud at a school lunch that the dinner ladies gave it a round of applause.

x_spice_jar.lore.uncommon: Has a label so faded that the cook sniffs it every time to guess what's inside.

x_tea.lore.uncommon: Gets left to go cold on the windowsill while its maker answers the door.

x_aerosol.lore.uncommon: Sputters out its last puff in a sad little cough and then pretends it is still full.

x_almond.lore.rare: Hides in the bottom of the cereal bag and waits for the moment a spoon gets bored.

x_bacon.lore.uncommon: Spits a speck of hot fat at the cook's wrist the moment they lean in to check.

x_bleach.lore.epic: Scrubbed the grout so white before a visit that the visitors asked if the bathroom was new.

x_bottle_cap.lore.uncommon: Pings off the counter when twisted too hard and lands in the dog's water bowl.

x_candle_jar.lore.rare: Makes a whole evening feel slower and softer, until somebody blows it out and the spell breaks.

x_coffee_bag.lore.rare: Puffs its rich smell through the valve every time the cupboard door bumps it.

x_dish_soap.lore.uncommon: Stands on the windowsill with a crust of dried bubbles round its lid.

x_drumstick_chicken.lore.epic: Was dropped at a picnic, bounced once on the blanket and was caught by the dog in mid-air.

x_flour.lore.common: Gets measured out with a mug because the scales are always somewhere else.

x_jerry_can.lore.rare: Makes a car smell so strongly of fuel that the windows stay open the whole drive.

x_kebab.lore.legendary: Held so many chunks on one skewer that it needed two cooks to turn it, one at each end.
